title: deparia sichuanensis var. jinfoshanensis

It is a rare and endemic plant species found in the mountainous regions of China, used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Deparia sichuanensis var. jinfoshanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
